name: wait_for_slot_release_loop
description: When either of two slot status words equals 2, it clears a flag word, calls a library routine with a fixed string, sets a busy flag, then repeatedly polls a routine and invokes a library call until the slots leave state 2 or a stop byte is set. It then clears the busy flag and the stop byte.

name: clear_busy_and_stop_flags
description: Sets a 16-bit flag word to zero and clears a byte flag in the shared data area.

name: read_line_and_send_text
description: Draws a prompt area, reads a line into a 40-byte buffer, terminates it with a carriage return, and passes it to a library send call. A check for exactly three plus signs selects a branch, but both branches make the same call.

name: send_fixed_command_string
description: Stores a fixed four-byte sequence ending in a carriage return in a local buffer and passes its address to a library send routine.

name: show_opponent_quit_notice
description: Passes the address of a global message buffer to a library routine. The referenced text, Your Opponent just quit, identifies the message.

name: pick_box_value_or_input
description: When a slot is in state 2, it waits for a pending input byte, clears it and returns it. Otherwise it draws a sequence of panel elements, waits for an event with the pointer inside a 128 by 56 area, and returns the table byte for the column under the pointer.

name: take_pending_input_byte
description: Returns the byte held in a global input slot and resets that slot to zero.

name: wait_for_box_click_selection
description: Draws a sequence of panel elements, waits for an event with the pointer inside a 128 by 56 area, and returns the table byte for the column under the pointer.

name: wait_for_box_click_selection
description: Draws a sequence of panel elements, waits for an event with the pointer inside a 128 by 56 area, and returns the table byte for the column under the pointer.

name: wait_for_promotion_piece_choice
description: Draws a sequence of panel elements, waits for an event with the pointer inside a 128 by 56 area, and returns the table byte under the pointer. The referenced text Promote pawn to? marks this as a piece choice prompt.

name: wait_for_pointer_in_box
description: Polls for an event until the pointer lies inside a 128 by 56 area, marks an input state flag, and returns the table byte for the column under the pointer.

name: draw_converging_segment_strokes
description: Sets a drawing colour, draws a segment between two points, then draws three further segments whose endpoints move one pixel per step.

name: update_indexed_marker_if_changed
description: Stores the new value when it differs from the saved byte, then draws an entry using a pointer table and a byte table indexed by that value. A value of 4 uses different offsets in the draw call.

name: partition_memory_and_init_resources
description: Splits a 40000-byte block into sub-tables by advancing an offset with per-entry sizes and storing their addresses in pointer slots. It then calls library routines to set up and load resources and builds a 17-entry pointer and size table.

name: set_resource_pointer_table
description: Stores pointers to two records, each made of a 264-byte block followed by a 60-byte block, in global slots.

name: initialise_state_tables_and_pointers
description: Clears six bytes and sets eight bytes to 255, then assigns five pointer slots and calls library routines to load and draw a resource. One of two branches chooses different pointer values, and the routine ends with a library refresh call.

name: set_five_pointer_slots
description: Calls library routines to load and draw a resource, sets five pointer slots to fixed table positions, then calls a library refresh routine.

name: xor_block_into_shifted_copy
description: Calls library routines to select a resource and clear a buffer, then XORs 39960 bytes of a source block into a destination that starts 40 bytes later.

name: save_state_snapshot
description: Copies two pointer slots, four 16-bit words and one 32-bit value into a saved-state area.

name: restore_state_snapshot
description: Copies the saved-state area back into two pointer slots, four 16-bit words and one 32-bit value.

name: copy_state_to_backup_slots
description: Copies two pointer slots, four 16-bit words and one 32-bit value into a second backup area of the saved state.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine that only returns; it performs no work.

name: xor_sprite_rows_into_table
description: Walks a zero-terminated list and, for each entry, records an index and a pointer in a table, then XORs a block of bytes with a row-shifted copy whose size comes from the entry's two byte fields. It stores the advanced pointer and count when it finishes.

name: build_sprite_layout_table
description: Clears a 256-entry index table and marks the entries used by a byte list, then gives each used entry a sequential index. It records a pointer and size for each active entry and calls library routines to set up each part.

name: remove_slot_and_compact_records
description: Clears the active flag for one of six slots and moves the records stored for that slot to the free end of the table. It then subtracts a delta from the pointer fields of the remaining slots, with the record count taken from a library call result.

name: compact_slot_records_by_index
description: Copies the records for the slot selected by a register index to the free end of the table, subtracting a delta from the pointer fields of the other slots.

name: copy_records_with_delta
description: Copies a list of short records into a record buffer while subtracting a delta from each value, and updates the pointer and count fields that track the buffer's fill point.

name: finish_record_compaction
description: Stores the carried pointers, subtracts a count from the offsets of the affected slots, then copies the remaining entries and reduces the stored entry count.

name: shift_records_and_shrink_count
description: Subtracts a delta from every entry offset, moves the trailing entries down, and reduces the entry count by the size difference of the slot.

name: shrink_entry_count_by_slot
description: Reduces the stored entry count by the size difference recorded for one slot.

name: activate_slot_with_index_list
description: Marks one of six slots as active and saves its current record pointers and entry count. It then fills a byte index list from zero up to the slot's count, terminated by 255, and passes that list to a library routine.

name: mark_slot_and_advance_pointer
description: Marks a slot as active, records the current pointer, and calls a library routine for the slot's entry. It then advances the pointer by a size rounded up to an even count returned from another library call.

name: fill_free_space_with_slots
description: Sums the sizes of unused slots, then repeatedly picks slots with a sentinel marker and reduces the remaining free count by each chosen size. For the chosen pair it updates pointer fields and draws the two entries through library calls before clearing flags.

name: fill_free_space_alt_path
description: Repeats the slot selection loop and reduces the free count by each chosen slot's size. When no slot is left, it falls back to an error path, otherwise it records the leftover slot and clears the flags.

name: pick_slots_while_space_remains
description: Repeatedly chooses an unused slot and reduces the remaining free count by its size until the count is no longer below the target. It then calls a library routine to finish the slot list.

name: pick_slots_until_memory_error
description: Loops while free space remains, choosing unused slots and drawing their entries through library calls. When no slot fits, it calls the routine that reports the referenced not enough memory error text.

name: pick_slots_until_full
description: Loops choosing slots by their size and drawing their entries until the remaining free count is used up. It calls the error reporter when no slot can be placed.

name: draw_chosen_slot_pair
description: Clears the per-slot flags, draws the two chosen slot entries through library calls, and resets the marker flags.

name: push_value_to_small_stack
description: Pushes a 32-bit value onto a four-entry stack kept in globals. When the stack is already full, it calls the error routine that references the text error 104.

name: pop_stack_with_table_store
description: Returns the next value from the four-entry stack when one is available and stores a 16-bit word from the caller's table first when a flag check passes. Without an available value it calls a fallback routine.

name: pop_small_stack_or_fallback
description: Returns the next value from the four-entry stack when one is available, otherwise calls a fallback routine for the value.

name: report_error_103
description: Passes the referenced error 103 message to the error reporting routine and returns.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only a stub: the decompiled body is bad instruction data, so there is no behaviour to describe.

name: push_value_to_second_stack
description: Pushes a 32-bit value onto a second four-entry stack. When that stack is full, it calls the error routine for the referenced error 102 text.

name: build_blit_command_list
description: Compares two four-byte rectangle descriptors, fills an output record with merged bounds, and writes a sequence of 16-bit and 32-bit command words to a shared output port through library draw calls.

name: pop_second_stack_or_error
description: Returns the next value from the second four-entry stack when one is available. When the stack is empty it calls the error routine that references the text error 101.

name: build_blit_list_truncated
description: Decompiled output stops at a bad-instruction warning partway through, so only the readable first part is described: it merges two rectangle descriptors into an output record and writes command words to a shared output port.

name: wait_while_status_bit_set
description: Busy-waits on a status word that is read from the DMA control register until the bit with value 64 is clear, then returns.

name: call_three_unnamed_routines
description: Pseudo-code is unavailable because the decompiler timed out, so its exact behaviour cannot be read. It is entered by address and makes calls to three other unnamed routines.

name: build_blit_rect_pair
description: Merges two rectangle descriptors into an output record and writes a sequence of command words to a shared output port. When the second descriptor is non-empty it writes a second set of command words for it.

name: build_blit_rect_pair_alt
description: Merges two rectangle descriptors with the first descriptor's position as the base, writes its command words, and writes a second set for the second descriptor when it is non-empty.

name: build_blit_rect_pair_swapped
description: Merges two rectangle descriptors with the first rectangle's horizontal fields taken from the second descriptor, writes command words, and writes a second set for the second descriptor when it is non-empty.

name: build_blit_rect_from_first
description: Stores the first rectangle's vertical fields in an output record, writes command words for it, and writes a second set for the second rectangle when it is non-empty.

name: build_blit_rect_merged_second
description: Merges the second rectangle's vertical bounds into the output record, writes command words, and writes a second set for the second descriptor when it is non-empty.

name: build_blit_rect_from_second
description: Stores the second rectangle's vertical fields in an output record, writes command words using the first rectangle's position, and writes a second set for the second descriptor when it is non-empty.

name: program_blitter_rect_copy
description: Merges two rectangle descriptors and writes the blitter's pointer, modulo, control and size registers through the shared register port, enabling DMA. A second set of register writes follows when the second descriptor is non-empty.

name: program_blitter_from_table
description: Writes the blitter's control, modulo, pointer and size registers from fixed globals and table entries, calling a library routine between writes, with the DMA control register set to enable the blitter channels.

name: unlink_entry_from_list
description: Walks a zero-terminated linked list of records. When it finds the given record, it replaces the link that points to it with that record's next link, stored at a fixed offset of 28 bytes.

name: handle_undecompiled_routine
description: Pseudo-code is unavailable because the decompiler timed out, so the behaviour cannot be read. The routine has 27 instructions and is called from two unnamed routines.

name: call_routines_with_word_argument
description: Calls two unnamed routines with no arguments, then calls a third with the 16-bit argument it was given. It is called from 18 unnamed routines.

name: reset_record_fields_and_call
description: Calls a routine with the record pointer and with the record's word at offset 2, then clears the record's 32-bit field at offset 20 and its byte at offset 11.

name: drain_linked_list_entries
description: Repeatedly passes the head of a list to a removal routine until the list head is empty.

name: handle_undecompiled_large_routine
description: Pseudo-code is unavailable because the decompiler timed out, so the behaviour cannot be read. The routine has 153 instructions, is called from two unnamed routines and makes three calls to other unnamed routines.

name: blit_grid_cell_rectangle
description: Converts four grid coordinates into a pixel rectangle with 16-pixel cells and computes its width, height and byte size. When the computed size is too large it calls the error routine that references the text error 01, then programs the blitter registers for the rectangle.

name: draw_overlapping_list_records
description: Walks the linked record list and, for each record whose bounds overlap the current rectangle, draws its entries through blitter helper calls. A stored record pointer limits the draw to that single record when it is set.

name: program_blitter_for_bitmap
description: Computes blitter size and control words from a bitmap's width, height and pointer, then writes the blitter registers with a fixed mask set, calling library routines between writes.

name: program_blitter_masked_bitmap
description: Computes blitter size and control words from a bitmap's dimensions, then writes the blitter registers with a different mask pattern from the similar routine, including first-word and last-word masks.

name: fill_sprite_slot_record
description: Fills a 32-byte record in a table with the given position, computes its far corner from a size entry, stores a pointer, sets a byte to 255 and clears a flag.

name: render_string_list_lines
description: Walks a list of zero-terminated strings and, for each character, computes a position from a width and offset, then calls library routines to draw it. It sets a fixed value of 25 and a starting offset before the loop.

name: draw_row_grid_upward
description: While a vertical counter is above 25, steps it up by 8 and draws a horizontal row of cells with a loop over an entry count, then draws a closing cell for the row.

name: reset_marker_and_draw_entries
description: Clears a 255 marker and a counter, makes library calls with a value of 200, then loops over the list entries with a starting step of 48.

name: lookup_selected_pair_value
description: Returns a 16-bit value from a table entry chosen by two selector bytes, but only when both selectors are valid and the entry's flag byte is set. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: store_entry_pointer_and_mode
description: Stores the pointer from a table entry in a global, sets a byte to 25 when the second argument is non-zero and to zero otherwise, and calls a library routine with those values.

name: select_threshold_slot
description: Finds the first of five threshold entries that is not below a given value. When that index differs from the current selection, it calls library routines to switch to it.

name: copy_string_and_pad_spaces
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from a table entry into a local buffer, then fills the rest of the buffer with spaces up to a width derived from a counter.

name: toggle_selector_and_refresh
description: Toggles a 16-bit selector between zero and one, loads the matching stored pointer into a global and calls a routine. When a flag byte is set it also calls library routines with a derived value.

name: lookup_grid_cell_coordinates
description: For a value below 64 while a flag is clear, splits it into a row and a column index and reads coordinate values from two position tables. It then calls two unnamed routines with the computed values.

name: fill_rect_in_row_strips
description: Stores the given horizontal range, then repeatedly computes a strip height by dividing 812 by the row width and calls routines for each strip until the total pixel count is used up.

name: shuffle_fifteen_word_table
description: Shuffles a table of 15 16-bit entries by swapping each entry with a later entry whose index comes from a library call result.

name: and_mask_rows_into_buffer
description: Walks a buffer and ANDs each byte with a 16-entry word table selected by a rolling index, calling a routine whenever the outer counter passes its limit.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine that only returns; it performs no work.

name: wait_for_message_code_104
description: Loops, fetching messages through library calls and replying to each, until a message whose type field equals 104 has been received.

name: poll_messages_until_code_104
description: Fetches messages through library calls and replies to each one. It sets a stop flag once a message whose type field equals 104 arrives, then returns.

name: open_graphics_and_intuition_libraries
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries through library calls. On failure it reports the referenced unable to open graphics library or unable to open intuition library message.

name: open_screen_and_window
description: Opens a screen and then a window through library calls. It reports the referenced unable to open a screen or unable to open a window message when either call returns nothing.

name: pass_argument_to_library
description: Passes a stored handle, the argument and a length of 32 bytes to a library routine.

name: pass_buffer_to_library
description: Passes a stored handle, the address of a fixed buffer in the data area and a length of 32 bytes to a library routine.

name: release_screen_and_window_handles
description: Passes the stored screen handle and then the stored window handle to library routines, one after the other.

name: release_graphics_and_intuition
description: Passes the stored intuition and graphics library handles to the same library routine, one after the other.

name: format_decimal_digits
description: Writes a decimal number into a character buffer by recursing on the higher digits and writing each digit from a library conversion result. An input of zero writes a single 0 character.

name: write_single_digit_char
description: Converts a value through a library routine, writes one decimal digit character at the buffer pointer, advances the pointer and returns it.

name: build_index_lookup_tables
description: Scans a flag table and, for each non-zero flag, records the entry's index in two lookup tables.

name: compute_line_x_position
description: Computes the horizontal position along a line segment from the difference between two points, using integer division by a step size with a half-step rounding term, and stores the result.

name: compute_line_x_from_frame
description: Computes a horizontal position from an offset, a scaled step and a rounded division by a width, and stores it. It also stores a vertical position when the second value is negative.

name: compute_line_y_position
description: Computes a vertical position from a scaled offset and a rounded division by a width, then stores it and returns.

name: store_selector_on_command_five
description: When the command code is 5, it looks up a byte in a table using the argument and stores its low three bits into one of two selector bytes, chosen by the argument's flag.

name: append_to_slot_chain
description: Stores a masked table value into a ring counter, advances the counter modulo 32, and links the new entry into a chain of 8-byte records, walking the chain to its end when the head is not free.

name: append_flagged_slot_chain
description: Sets a slot flag when the argument is not the eighth code, advances the ring counter modulo 32, and walks an 8-byte record chain to append the next entry.

name: append_record_to_chain_end
description: Walks a chain of 8-byte records to its last entry, then writes a new record with the ring counter value and the given fields, linking it into the chain.

name: initialise_chain_record
description: Sets the head link of a chain record to the ring counter, stores the given fields in a new 8-byte record, and marks its links as end of chain.

name: call_single_chain_routine
description: Calls a single unnamed routine and returns.

name: store_event_record
description: Advances the ring counter modulo 32, stores the two parameter bytes into a new 8-byte record with end-of-chain markers, then calls two unnamed routines.

name: lookup_table_byte_and_return
description: Stores a masked byte from a table, selected by an index, into a global, and returns the value of another global byte.

name: mark_flag_from_table_index
description: When the argument is not the eighth code, sets a flag byte chosen by a table lookup on the argument, then returns a global byte.

name: allocate_node_from_record
description: Reads the fields of an 8-byte record selected by the argument, marks it as in use, allocates a new node through an unnamed routine, copies the fields into it and links it into a node list.

name: append_node_to_list
description: Adds the given node to the end of a linked list whose head is stored in a global. If the list is empty, the node becomes the head.

name: link_node_after_tail
description: Walks from a given node to the tail of its linked list, then links the new node after it and clears the new node's next pointer.

name: link_node_after_given
description: Sets the given node's next pointer to the new node and clears the new node's next pointer.

name: unlink_node_and_release
description: Finds the node's predecessor in the list whose head is stored in a global, replaces its link with the node's next link, then passes the node to an unnamed routine.

name: scan_node_list_for_result
description: Walks the node list from its global head. It returns 1 when the list is empty, otherwise it checks each node and returns the result of the scan.

name: process_list_entry_fields
description: Calls an unnamed routine on the entry and, when the result is non-zero, copies the entry's pointer and fields. The pointer comes from the entry or from a table, depending on a flag byte, and a second routine is then called.

name: fill_entry_from_token_table
description: Reads a pointer from a token stream and fills an entry record from a table or a computed value, depending on a flag byte in the record. It then calls three unnamed routines.

name: count_tokens_until_terminator
description: Advances through a list of 16-bit tokens until the terminator value is reached, counting them in a byte field of the record. It then stores a table pointer and sets a flag byte in the record.

name: set_entry_defaults_from_token
description: Sets a record's count byte to 8 and its flag byte to 1. When a state word is zero, it reads the next token and computes a pointer from it.

name: load_token_pointer_and_values
description: Reads the next token to compute a pointer, looks up a 16-bit value from a table indexed by a record byte, stores the value in a global, then calls two unnamed routines.

name: advance_token_while_below_limit
description: When the record's counter is below its limit, it loads a pointer from a stored node, calls two unnamed routines with the argument, and advances the token position.

name: load_node_and_call_routines
description: Loads a pointer from a stored node, reads the next token to compute a pointer, calls five unnamed routines, then stores the result for the next entry.

name: mark_record_done_and_return
description: Sets the 16-bit field at offset 8 of a record to 1, stores the current token pointer in the output slot, and returns zero.

name: draw_quartex_text_screen
description: Draws a screen containing the referenced text Quartex 1988: by calling six unnamed routines to set up its layout and show it.

name: decrement_field_and_call_check
description: Decrements a 16-bit field by eight, calls an unnamed routine with the argument and a global, and returns zero or a value depending on its result. Its pointer arithmetic looks decoded from data, so only the calls are reliable.

name: load_entry_fields_from_table
description: Reads an entry's pointer and, when it is zero, takes the pointer from a table indexed by a stored value. It copies two fields from a second record into the entry, then calls two unnamed routines.

name: count_tokens_halved_if_flag
description: Counts 16-bit tokens up to the terminator and halves the count when a flag byte is zero.

name: store_halved_count_and_scan
description: Stores the halved token count in the record and clears its flag byte, then loads a pointer from a table and calls three unnamed routines with the data it reads.

name: emit_entry_and_advance_flag
description: Loads a node pointer, reads a value through an unnamed routine, advances the record's flag byte, and calls six unnamed routines to process the entry.

name: store_pointer_return_zero
description: Stores the current token pointer in the output slot and returns zero.

name: reset_flag_and_process_entry
description: Clears a record's flag byte when it is zero, takes a pointer from the record or from a table, and calls an unnamed routine with values derived from that pointer.

name: clear_flag_and_load_entry
description: Clears a record's flag byte, loads a pointer from a table when the stored pointer is zero, and calls two unnamed routines with the resulting values.

name: pass_fields_to_five_calls
description: Reads a value through an unnamed routine, passes it with the record fields to other unnamed routines, and makes five calls in total.

name: store_pointer_return_zero
description: Stores the current token pointer in the output slot and returns zero.

name: replay_byte_command_stream
description: Walks a byte stream while its values are at least 128 and not the terminator. For each command it calls an unnamed routine with a table entry and the byte minus 64, and it only runs while a state word is zero.

name: replay_command_stream_from_entry
description: Walks a byte stream of commands from the entry's pointer, calling an unnamed routine with a table entry and the byte value minus 64 for each command, while a state word is zero.

name: read_next_stream_byte
description: Stores the next byte from a stream into a record byte and advances the stream. When the stream reaches the terminator value, it clears the record byte instead.

name: read_stream_byte_return_one
description: Stores the next byte from a stream into a record byte, advances the stream, and returns one.

name: clear_record_byte_return_one
description: Clears a byte field of the record and returns one.

name: emit_flagged_record_fields
description: When the record's counter is non-zero and its flag byte is one, copies its position fields and flag into a local record and calls two unnamed routines with it.

name: compute_tile_index_and_draw
description: Derives a tile index from two position bytes by masking and shifting, builds a pair of values for a rectangle, and calls two unnamed routines with them.

name: test_table_bit_for_index
description: Computes an index from the low three bits of a value and a shifted, inverted field, then calls an unnamed routine with the table bit at that index masked with 64 and the index.

name: choose_tile_variant_by_position
description: When the first argument is six, chooses a variant code of 3 or 7 depending on whether the position's low three bits are below 4, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: clear_long_buffer_block
description: Writes zero to a block of 512 consecutive 32-bit entries starting at a fixed address, then calls two unnamed routines.

name: return_half_of_routine_result
description: Calls three unnamed routines and returns half the value from the last one when a flag is set.

name: adjust_length_counter_if_odd
description: When the low bit of a register word is set and two address registers match, adds the difference between them to a stored counter. Otherwise it returns the register values unchanged.

name: shift_out_eight_bits
description: Loops over eight bit positions, shifting a register left and calling an unnamed routine for each bit that is shifted out.

name: classify_256_table_entries
description: Walks a 256-entry table of 16-bit pairs and, for each entry whose second value is non-zero, classifies the value against small thresholds and writes the result into a scratch array.

name: scan_first_set_bit_entry
description: Scans a flag word bit by bit for the first set bit, then processes the matching entry through unnamed routines, with three unnamed calls in total.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine that only returns; it performs no work.

name: advance_counter_or_return_pair
description: When a counter register is non-zero, returns a pair of values built from a word and the input registers. Otherwise it adds a fixed 512-byte difference to a stored counter and calls an unnamed routine.

name: scan_bits_with_count_decrement
description: Decrements a stored 16-bit count, scans a flag word for set bits, and processes the matching entry through unnamed routines.

name: clear_flag_read_byte_bits
description: Clears a 16-bit flag, calls an unnamed routine, advances a counter, and reads a byte from a pointer to set up bit values for the following steps.

name: advance_counter_by_offset_difference
description: Computes the difference between two stored addresses offset by 512, adds it to a stored counter, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: initialise_buffer_and_clear_flag
description: Calls a library routine on a fixed buffer with a constant value, makes three unnamed calls, and clears a 16-bit flag.

name: dispatch_mode_word_routine
description: Calls an unnamed routine and then branches on a mode value stored in a 16-bit global. A zero value calls one unnamed routine, and other values select different branches.

name: set_two_flags_and_run
description: Calls two unnamed routines, sets two 16-bit flags to one, calls another unnamed routine, and runs further steps when a state word is zero.

name: copy_entry_table_reverse
description: Moves 8-byte entries in a table toward higher positions, copying from the highest index downward and starting from a stored counter.

name: remove_first_entry_and_shift
description: Decrements a stored counter, then copies each following 8-byte entry one position forward so the first entry is overwritten.

name: reset_fields_and_branch
description: Clears two 16-bit fields, sets another to 23, calls two unnamed routines, then branches on a flag byte.

name: loop_three_calls_per_step
description: After an initial call, runs a loop of unnamed routine calls that makes three calls on each iteration.

name: reset_counter_and_copy_longs
description: Sets a 16-bit counter to minus one and copies two 32-bit values from stored globals into another pair of globals.

name: store_two_bytes_in_entry
description: Writes the two bytes of the first argument into a four-byte table entry selected by the low word of the second argument.

name: reset_fields_then_run_steps
description: Clears two 16-bit fields, calls an unnamed routine and runs further steps depending on its result, with six unnamed calls in total.

name: dispatch_command_switch
description: Clears a 16-bit field and dispatches on the low byte of a command word through a switch. The default case resets the command word to zero.

name: reset_command_and_refresh
description: Calls two unnamed routines, resets the command word to zero, then calls another unnamed routine.

name: run_two_pass_routine_loop
description: Clears a 16-bit index and a flag, then loops calling unnamed routines, choosing a branch from the index value, and returns an integer result.

name: reset_state_and_call_eight
description: Makes four unnamed calls, clears two 16-bit fields, and makes further calls, eight unnamed calls in total.

name: show_resignation_message
description: Copies a stored state pair into a backup area and calls ten unnamed routines to display the referenced messages Blue resigns or Red resigns.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine that only returns; it performs no work.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine that only returns; it performs no work.

name: pick_table_index_and_call
description: Picks a stop index by comparing the low 4 bits of a library call result with a table of thresholds, then loops calling unnamed routines that many times.

name: compare_positions_and_copy
description: Sets a flag byte and calls unnamed routines, clears a 16-bit field, and copies a value when one stored position is below another. Four unnamed calls are made in total.

name: update_counter_and_flags
description: Increments a 16-bit counter and sets a flag when a stored value is below a limit, otherwise it sets a sentinel value. It makes eight unnamed calls in total.

name: read_until_flagged_value
description: Reads a value through an unnamed routine. When it is below 128, loops reading further values until one has bit 64 set, then returns the result.

name: poll_until_flag_bit_set
description: Repeatedly reads a value through an unnamed routine until its bit with value 64 is set, calling another unnamed routine between reads.

name: count_high_values_in_reads
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter and reads values through an unnamed routine, counting those at or above 128 until the loop ends.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine that only returns; it performs no work.

name: store_library_result_twice
description: Calls a library routine with an argument of zero and stores the 32-bit result in two global slots.

name: store_result_and_difference
description: Calls a library routine with an argument of zero, stores the result, and stores the difference between that result and a previously saved value.

name: add_difference_to_indexed_slot
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then adds a stored 32-bit difference to the slot selected by the argument's low word in a 4-byte table.

name: forward_arguments_to_routine
description: Passes its two arguments unchanged to another unnamed routine and returns.

name: append_timed_entry_to_table
description: Writes a pair of 32-bit values into the table entry after the current counter, copies them into two stored slots, and makes one unnamed call.

name: swap_slot_pair_and_count
description: Increments a 16-bit counter and a second counter, calls an unnamed routine with the arguments, and swaps two 16-bit slots.

name: swap_slot_pair_and_uncount
description: Swaps two 16-bit slots, calls an unnamed routine with the arguments, then decrements the two counters that the earlier routine incremented.

name: call_around_table_lookup
description: Calls an unnamed routine with the arguments, reads a byte from a 32-byte-stride table at the index stored in a global, calls the same routine again, and returns the byte value.

name: dispatch_command_cases
description: A switch on the low byte of a command word with several cases. Case 3 calls an unnamed routine and then resets the command word to zero, and a 16-bit result is returned.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine that only returns; it performs no work.

name: call_single_unnamed_routine
description: Makes a single call to an unnamed routine and returns.

name: set_state_from_command_byte
description: Stores the high byte of a command word into a state word, then sets a timer value of 6 when the new state is zero and branches on other states, including 10, to make calls.

name: handle_state_ten_setup
description: When the state word equals 10, calls two unnamed routines, reads a value through another unnamed routine and stores it, and restores the state word from a saved value when that read returns zero.

name: restore_state_from_saved_value
description: Copies a saved 16-bit value back into the state word and returns.

name: set_timer_from_state_shift
description: Sets a timer value to five shifted left by one less than the state word, then clears two 32-bit counters.

name: start_timer_with_minimum_three
description: Sets two 16-bit flags, copies the timer value into a second timer, and raises it to 3 when it is below 3.

name: copy_bytes_with_count
description: Copies bytes from a source to a destination one at a time for a 16-bit count given as the third argument.

name: compare_bytes_up_to_count
description: Compares two byte sequences one byte at a time for a given count, returning zero when the count is exhausted and stopping early at the first mismatch.

name: clear_list_entry_cells
description: Walks lists of entries in a table and, for each entry, writes a space character and a zero value into its cells.

name: reset_buffer_and_counter
description: Calls a library routine on a fixed buffer with a size of 524288 bytes, increments a 16-bit counter, copies two stored 32-bit values into slots, then runs a loop.

name: wait_until_pointer_pair_matches
description: Clears a byte flag, increments a 16-bit counter, then loops calling unnamed routines until two stored words match the pair of stored values.

name: poll_pair_match_then_copy
description: While a flag byte is set, calls an unnamed routine until two stored words match the pair of saved values, then copies a 32-bit value into the saved slot.

name: copy_grid_bytes_to_buffer
description: Writes a stored byte to the output buffer, then loops over a grid of entries, copying each selected byte into the buffer.

name: expand_grid_with_toggle_flag
description: Calls an unnamed routine, stores a byte from the argument as a word and a toggled copy as a second word, then loops calling routines over the grid entries.

name: check_red_piece_limit
description: Prepares a buffer with two library calls over the piece layout, scans it with an unnamed routine, and returns a pointer to a message. The referenced text Red has too many pieces is one of the messages it can return.

name: select_blue_piece_message
description: Compares stored piece counts against small thresholds and returns a pointer to one of several messages, including the referenced text Blue has too many pieces.

name: select_red_king_message
description: Compares stored king counts against small thresholds and returns a pointer to one of several messages, including the referenced text Red has too many Kings.
